context: Mei takes Hikari (use sho_child as small toddler stand-in) to her first swim lesson.
purpose: Mother encouraging child during a new milestone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, uncertain voice with a wobble on the open word. Seeking reassurance but trying to be brave. Soft at the end, like he's checking whether it's safe to admit it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: It's safe, sweetheart. You'll be fine.
lines.style: Warm, grounded tone. Slow and patient. Settles him with her presence more than the words. A small smile underneath — she's heard this worry before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Will I be able to swim?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity mixed with doubt. He's testing the possibility out loud. His voice lifts slightly at the end — wanting to believe it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: The teacher will show you how.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Not dismissing his worry but offering the next solid step. Warmth in the rhythm — she knows he just needs direction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, I'll give it a try!
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaks through. Small voice but steadier now. The shift from fear to determination happens fast — he's decided. Quiet conviction at the end.
